description: This is a test specification file for the sessions access and resolution modules of a software project, covering functions related to session visibility, agent-to-agent policies, and sandbox contexts using the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Determines the visibility setting for session tools, defaulting to 'tree' or accepting case-insensitive known values.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Resolves the effective session tools visibility considering sandbox restrictions.

methods.name: resolveSandboxSessionToolsVisibility
methods.description: Returns the default or configured sandbox session tools visibility clamp.

methods.name: resolveSandboxedSessionToolContext
methods.description: Generates the context for sandboxed session tools, including restrictions based on session and agent configuration.

methods.name: createAgentToAgentPolicy
methods.description: Creates a policy object to determine whether cross-agent messaging is permitted based on configuration.

methods.name: createSessionVisibilityGuard
methods.description: Creates a guard object that enforces session visibility rules based on the given configuration and actions.

ctags.name: policy
ctags.pattern: /^    const policy = createAgentToAgentPolicy({} as unknown as OpenClawConfig);$/
